    def objective(self) -> float:

        if self._mode == 'admit':
            value -= float(np.sum(Y))
        return value

    def _objective_terms(self):
        """Hessian and linear term of the rho-scaled sharing objective."""
        K = self._K

        hessian = path_based_projection_nnz(
            self._Y_tk, self._alpha_rows, self._alpha_cols, self._N, D,
            self.conditional_capacity) * self._rho
        hessian = hessian + np.eye(self._T, K)
        linear = np.zeros((self._T, K))

            col = self._alpha_cols[k]

                if self._capacities[n] > 0.0:

        if self._mode == 'admit':
            linear = linear - 1.0
        return hessian, linear
